# `wishes` — `/api/wishes`

The wish lamp: anyone in the Grove asks for something they want in it. Each wish is kept for the Grove's owners and managers, and emailed to GROVE_WISH_EMAIL when the server can send mail.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/wishes`](#post-api-wishes) | Member | Sends the host a wish: emailed when the Grove has an address for wishes and can send mail, otherwise kept for the host. |

<a id="post-api-wishes"></a>
### `POST /api/wishes`

Sends the host a wish: emailed when the Grove has an address for wishes and can send mail, otherwise kept for the host.

- Handler: [`make_wish`](../../../backend/community/wishes.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Wish`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 4000 characters |
| `page` | string | no | `""` | at most 40 characters; matches `^[a-z-]*$` |
| `space_id` | string | no | `""` | at most 64 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `id`, `emailed`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | Try again in 15 minutes. | `count_use` |
